Get your day out of your head and into the world

Most planners ask what matters most. That question is useless at 3pm on four hours of sleep. MYND asks what you have in you right now, and builds the day out of that instead.

Download on theApp Store Get it onGoogle Play

Step 1

Empty the whole backlog out of your head.

Step 2

Lay it across the hours you are awake for.

Step 3

Do one thing, with someone else in the room.

In your hands

Four moments, on an ordinary day.

  1. The whole day in one view: what is already done, what is next, and one tap into a brain dump when your head is too full to sort itself.

  2. The block starts and your phone says so. Screen off, app closed, no signal - the reminder still lands at the minute, not twenty past it.

  3. A chat that has read your whole week. It sees the slump before you admit to it, sends you out for twenty minutes, then moves the work and sets the reminder itself.

  4. Body doubling on demand. Two people, one shared timer, no small talk - the room is quiet and the work is the only thing happening in it.

01 / 04

Energy, not priority

Three levels: high, low, brain-dead. Every task carries one, and the day is built to match the level you are on.

A backlog you can prune

Swipe a task away when the honest answer is never. A list you cannot cut stops being a plan and becomes a monument.

Reminders that arrive

Screen off, app closed, no signal. They still land at the minute you set, not twenty past it.
